item.description: Jeannette Elaine “Jeanne” Doty-Burton, age 78, passed away on Monday, January 5, 2026 at CenterpointMedical Center in Independence, MO. She was born October 3, 1947 in Butler, MO. item.description: Butler fire and first responders are in route to a rollover accident on H highway near Spruce and it is being reported that the vehicle is on fire.Please use extreme caution if traveling in the area or avoid altogether.Additional details to be posted as they become available.

item.title: Obituary - Sherry Denise Moore (Greenwell)

item.title: Obituary - Ricky "Rick" Cantrell Jr.
item.description: Ricky "Rick" Cantrell Jr. age 58 of Harrisonville, Missouri departed this life Tuesday, January 6, 2026 at his home in Harrisonville, Missouri. Cremation with a celebration of life service will be held at a later date. A complete obituary will be posted once that information becomes available, courtesy Dickey Funeral Home.

item.title: Obituary - Nettie Louise Chadd
item.description: Nettie Louise Chadd, 71, passed away on Wednesday, January 7, 2026, at her home in Milo, MO. Nettie was born on April 17, 1954, in Joplin, MO to Warden and Laura (Cartwright) Pate. She married Glenn R. Chadd on December 24, 1983, and he survives of the home. Nettie grew up in Louisiana and Nevada, MO. She was a graduate of Nevada High School. item.title: Cold front inbound
item.description: A cold front is pushing through the region. Overnight in the upper 30's, with 40's for a high on Friday. Winter weather advisory already out for SW Kansas. Snow will be heaviest there tomorrow.
